output.headline: Provider-focused sponsor that has closed 13 of 14 deals and pays a 16.5x median, enough to meet upper-quartile pricing for this target.
output.differentiator: Best completion record among sponsors on the list (13 of 14 closed, 93%), and a 16.5x median price paid, second only to Blackstone. [K:closed_share, T:record]
output.why_them: Provider-focused sponsor; pays upper-quartile prices; closes what it starts

acquirer_overview.title: A growth equity investor with a provider-heavy record since 2019
points: Growth equity firm investing across Technology, Consumer, Financial Services, Healthcare and Life Sciences; AUM US$125.3 billion. [P:1, P:2]
14 deals from 2019 to 2024, 13 closed (93%), all control deals; 9 of 14 are provider deals. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share, A:angles]
Home sub-sector is Physician Groups, where 4 of its 14 deals sit. [B:buyer, K:by_sub_sector]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Provider specialist with size fit; one deal in the target's own sub-sector
points: Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors and the share of its deals that closed (93%) are modest factors in its likelihood. [S:sector_rel, S:close_rate_s, K:closed_share]
Market Share (revenue synergies) is a motive in 5 of 14 deals against 19% across the file, a distinct pattern. [M:market_share]
Against: a slight factor is its low share of deals in the target's own sub-sector, and it has no open platform. [S:sector_share, A:angles]

precedent_activity.title: Record spans a $1,708M own-sub-sector merger to small provider deals
points: Oak Health, Healthcare Services: $1,708M Merger of Equals in 2021 at 18.8x, in the target's own sub-sector. [D:MA-2021-0066]
Crest Medical Practice, Physician Groups: $121M leveraged buyout in 2023 at 11.5x; only 3 of its 14 deals fall in the $100M-$400M band. [D:MA-2023-0499, K:size_band]
Harbor Home Health Partners: $15M Midwest strategic acquisition in 2022 at 16.9x; only 2 of its 14 deals were in the target's region. [D:MA-2022-0273, T:record]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, and its 16.5x median is above the range
points: 70 comparable deals: 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median, 15.3x at the 75th; the 75th percentile is defensible. [V:comps]
Target margin of 16.8% exceeds the comparable median of 12.9% and sits above 87% of comps, supporting upper-quartile pricing. [V:comps]
It has paid a 16.5x median; at 5.0x leverage the equity cheque is $128M, with IRR at the ask of 18.7% against a 20% target. [V:comps, V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.mitigant: Maximum price is $193M at the same exit and $216M at a 15.0x platform exit. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.reality: Only the platform exit clears the $200M value, yet it has no open platform. [V:lbo, X:target, A:angles]

risk_flags.title: Thin own-sub-sector depth
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector; that share is a slight factor against. [T:record, S:sector_share]
risk_flags.mitigant: 8 deals in adjacent provider sub-sectors, and Physician Groups is its home sub-sector. [T:record, B:buyer]
risk_flags.reality: Fit is real but broader than direct, which is why conviction is Medium. [C:conviction]

risk_flags.title: Crowded sponsor field
risk_flags.concern: Nordic Capital and Welsh Carson have open platforms; General Atlantic does not. [A:angles]
risk_flags.mitigant: Its 13 of 14 closed deals (93%) top every other sponsor on the list. [K:closed_share]
risk_flags.reality: Welsh Carson and GTCR each have 6 Midwest deals against its 2. [T:record]

conviction.rationale: 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 8 in adjacent provider sub-sectors support fit, but having no open platform in the sub-sector is neutral, not a positive. [C:conviction, T:record]
